note: Brown County KS adopted limited county zoning in 2025 (Resolution 2025-08). County zoning is published as a DOCX district map (site map 'District Map') and an interactive GIS Mapping page with no REST service URL found. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the county, state (ORKA, DASC) and city sites (Hiawatha, Horton, Sabetha) found no queryable zoning district polygon layer for Brown County KS. The Hiawatha zoning item found on ArcGIS is for Hiawatha, Iowa, not Kansas. The county GIS host did not respond to probing.
